# Ship to Live — 夏裕科技股份有限公司 — by Yufan Chen

> Ship to Live is the trading name of two companies founded by Yufan Chen — QY LLC in San Diego, California (US engagements) and 夏裕科技股份有限公司 in Taipei, Taiwan (Taiwan engagements, unified business number 90173045). Yufan Chen is an engineering leader and full-stack engineer, former CTO of TalentSmartEQ, working from San Diego, California and Taipei, Taiwan. He builds AI agents, RAG pipelines and automations into the databases, back offices and workflows a business already runs; ships mobile apps, websites and back ends; and does SEO, AEO and GEO so Google and AI engines name the business. Bilingual in English and Traditional Chinese (中文). Contact by email or through the contact form; phone is not published. Website: https://shiptolive.com/ · 中文版: https://shiptolive.com/zh/

## Services

- **AI agents & assistants** — assistants and RAG pipelines that answer from a company's own documents and data, with sources attached, and can act on them: look up the record, draft the reply, file the result. LangChain, LangGraph, ChromaDB, OpenAI and Claude.
- **Automation & integrations** — back-office automation, internal tools, admin consoles, APIs and webhooks (including Salesforce) connecting the systems a business already uses.
- **Mobile apps** — iPhone, Android and Mac from one codebase with Flutter or React Native / Expo, taken through App Store release.
- **Websites & web platforms** — bilingual (English / 中文) websites and PHP / Laravel platforms (memberships, checkout, assessments, reporting) on GCP Cloud Run with GitHub Actions CI/CD.
- **Search visibility — SEO, AEO & GEO** — technical SEO, structured data (JSON-LD) and an llms.txt layer so Google ranks a business and ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini cite it.
- **Project rescue & modernization** — takes over stalled builds and aging systems (including legacy PHP): finds what is actually blocking them, then fixes, modernizes and ships them.

## How a project runs

1. **Talk it through** — free first conversation.
2. **Scope and quote** — a short written plan with a fixed price, quoted in one email. Larger AI projects start with a two-week pilot on real data.
3. **Ship it live** — built, tested and deployed with permissions, logging and handover docs. The client owns the code and accounts.

## Data handling

What an agent can read and do is scoped up front, every action it takes is logged, and a person stays in the loop anywhere a mistake would be expensive.

## Experience

- **Ship to Live** — Founder & Principal Engineer, 2026 – present. Built the EQ 360 platform for LEADx / TalentSmartEQ (assessment engine, scoring, admin console, credit system in PHP/MySQL); shipped two App Store apps solo; bilingual client websites on GCP Cloud Run.
- **Get Real Gifts** (https://www.getrealgifts.com/) — Full-Stack Engineer, 2022 – 2026. Built the core gifting widget, embedded in a partner platform and used by 40 million members; built gift.me and led its SEO/GEO.
- **TalentSmartEQ** (https://www.talentsmarteq.com/) — Programmer to Senior Programmer to Chief Technology Officer (2013 – 2021), 2005 – 2021. Owned architecture, infrastructure and security for 20+ online assessments in 26 countries and up to 26 languages; built the Emotional Intelligence Appraisal for *Emotional Intelligence 2.0*, taken by over 1 million people; enterprise portals for 3M and Adobe; Salesforce REST integration.

## Projects

- **AI Visibility Checker** (in development) — https://shiptolive.com/projects/ai-visibility-checker/ — asks ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude the questions a business's customers ask, in English and Chinese, and reports whether the business is named, who is named instead, which sources the AI cites, and what to fix on the website (structured data, llms.txt, AI crawler access). Free early-access checks are available through the contact form.

## 中文摘要

夏裕科技股份有限公司（統一編號 90173045，品牌名 Ship to Live）是 Yufan Chen 創立的軟體工程公司，
在台灣台北與美國加州聖地牙哥兩地營運。Yufan Chen 是工程主管與全端工程師，曾任 TalentSmartEQ 技術長。服務項目：

1. **AI 代理與助理** — 依企業自己的文件與資料回答並附出處，還能實際動手（查紀錄、擬回覆、歸檔）。
2. **自動化與系統整合** — 內部工具、管理後台、API 與 webhook，把既有系統串起來。
3. **手機 App** — 以 Flutter 或 React Native／Expo 開發 iPhone、Android、Mac App 並上架。
4. **網站與網路平台** — 中英雙語網站與 PHP／Laravel 平台，部署於 GCP Cloud Run。
5. **搜尋能見度（SEO / AEO / GEO）** — 讓企業在 Google 與 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini 的回答中被找到與引用。
6. **專案救援與系統翻新** — 接手卡住的專案與老舊系統，找出真正卡住的地方，修好、翻新並上線。

合作流程：免費諮詢 → 書面規劃與固定報價 → 開發並正式上線。服務語言為中文（繁體）與英文；
台灣的案子由夏裕科技股份有限公司承接並開立統一發票，美國的案子由 QY LLC 承接。
聯絡方式：yufan@shiptolive.com 或網站上的聯絡表單（不公開電話）。
中文網站：https://shiptolive.com/zh/
